title: AbstentionBench
authors_zh: Polina Kirichenko、Mark Ibrahim、Kamalika Chaudhuri、Samuel J. Bell
paper_type_zh: 审计、污染或验证器鲁棒性论文
best_for_zh: 想复盘验证器、基准污染、奖励投机或可复现性风险的研究者。
one_line: AbstentionBench evaluates whether LLMs know when not to answer across unknown, underspecified, false-premise, subjective, and stale-information questions.
检验模型面对未知、歧义和过时问题时能否正确拒答，把“知道何时不答”纳入推理可靠性审计。
why: It is a direct audit surface for reasoning models: stronger reasoning can still fail if the model confidently answers unanswerable questions instead of abstaining.
inclusion_reason: Benchmark and failure-mode entry for epistemic boundaries, uncertainty handling, and refusal/abstention evaluation.

title: Problem
问题
html:
LLMs are rewarded for answering, yet a question can be unknown, stale, based on a false premise, subjective, or missing essential context. A confident answer in those cases can mislead; refusing an answerable question is also a failure.

This work asks whether models withhold a definitive answer at the right time. It provides a benchmark spanning six uncertainty scenarios and answerable controls, so abstention and ordinary answer accuracy can be measured separately.

真实提问可能答案未知、已过时、前提错误、带有主观性，或缺少必要信息。模型若仍给出确定答案会编造或误导；但对可回答问题一概拒答同样失败。

本文检验模型能否在恰当时机不作确定回答。它覆盖六类不确定情形和可回答对照题，将拒答表现与正常作答正确性分开衡量。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: AbstentionBench treats abstention as a calibrated decision under insufficient evidence, not a fixed refusal phrase or a safety-policy refusal. It combines 17 curated datasets with constructed underspecified versions of GSM8K, GPQA, and MMLU-Math, yielding 20 datasets and more than 35K questions across six cases: unknown answers, false premises, stale facts, subjective questions, missing context, and unclear intent. Every item states whether abstention is appropriate; most answerable items also retain a reference answer. A validated Llama 3.1 8B judge identifies whether a response genuinely abstains, while a separate judge scores correctness when answering was appropriate. Recall measures missed abstentions, precision exposes blanket refusal, and F1 balances both. This separation matters because a model can be accurate on answerable tasks yet confidently invent missing facts. The benchmark’s central finding is that scale alone does little for abstention, and reasoning fine-tuning lowers it by 24% on average even as reasoning-task accuracy rises, showing that longer reasoning does not necessarily mean better uncertainty handling.

AbstentionBench 把拒答视为证据不足时经过校准的决策，而不是套用一句拒绝模板，也不同于按安全政策拒绝。它整合 17 个筛选数据集，并从 GSM8K、GPQA、MMLU-Math 构造缺少关键条件的版本，形成 20 个数据集、超过 3.5 万道题，覆盖答案未知、错误前提、信息过时、主观问题、上下文不足和意图不清六种情形。每题都标有是否应拒答，多数可回答题还保留参考答案。经验证的 Llama 3.1 8B 判定器判断回答是否真正表达不确定性，另一判定器只在应作答时检查正确性；召回率衡量漏拒答，精确率防止一概拒绝，F1 平衡二者。这一区分很关键：模型可以答题很准，却在信息缺失时自信编造。论文发现，单纯扩模型对拒答帮助很小，推理微调平均反而使拒答下降 24%，即更长推理并不等于更会处理不确定性。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Screen 82 candidate resources and retain 17 existing datasets spanning unknown answers, false premises, stale facts, subjectivity, and underspecification.
  2. Create underspecified versions of GSM8K, GPQA, and MMLU-Math; combine them with UMWP to cover reasoning settings.
  3. Form 20 datasets with over 35,000 unanswerable prompts and answerable controls, capping each dataset at 3,500 examples.
  4. Sample model responses with a 4K generation limit under the stated decoding settings.
  5. Use Llama 3.1 8B Instruct with a yes/no rubric to judge abstention, and a separate judge for answer correctness where references exist.
  6. Report abstention recall, precision, F1, and response accuracy; compare scales, post-training, reasoning budgets, and a prompting intervention.

The paper releases the benchmark and evaluation code, but exact results depend on model version, prompt, decoder settings, and judge protocol.

1. 从 82 个候选资源中筛出 17 个现有数据集，覆盖未知答案、错误前提、过时信息、主观问题和信息不足。
  2. 删去 GSM8K、GPQA、MMLU-Math 中的关键条件，构造信息不足的推理题，并纳入 UMWP。
  3. 合成 20 个数据集、超过 3.5 万个不可确定作答的问题及可回答对照；每个数据集最多取 3500 条。
  4. 按论文设定生成回答，单次最多生成 4K token。
  5. 用 Llama 3.1 8B Instruct 按“是/否”规则判定是否拒答；有参考答案时另用判定器评估正确性。
  6. 统计拒答召回率、精确率、F1 和作答正确率，并比较规模、后训练、推理预算和系统提示。

数据与评测代码已公开；复现时需固定模型版本、提示词、解码参数和判定器协议。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
Claim: reasoning-oriented post-training can improve answering while making models less willing to abstain.

Setup: the authors evaluate 20 frontier models over 20 datasets, including DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-70B against Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct and s1.1 against Qwen2.5-32B.

Result: reasoning fine-tuning lowers abstention by 24% on average, including on math and science tasks; raising the reasoning-token budget generally worsens abstention further.

Boundary: this is behavior under this benchmark, prompt, and LLM-judge protocol, not a direct measurement of a model's internal uncertainty.

主张：面向推理的后训练可能提升答题能力，却降低模型应当拒答时的克制性。

设定：作者用 20 个数据集评测 20 个前沿模型，比较 DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-70B 与 Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct，以及 s1.1 与 Qwen2.5-32B。

结果：推理微调平均使拒答表现下降 24%，数学和科学题也如此；增加推理 token 预算通常会进一步恶化拒答。

边界：这是特定题集、提示词和模型判定器下的行为结果，不能直接等同于模型内部不确定性的测量。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Earlier QA or refusal tests usually isolate one failure mode. AbstentionBench places six uncertainty scenarios and answerable controls in one protocol, then separates refusal quality from answer correctness. Its important finding is diagnostic: more reasoning and higher accuracy need not mean better uncertainty handling.
以往问答或拒答测试多只检查一种失败情形。该基准把六类不确定问题和可回答对照放进同一协议，并把拒答质量与答案正确性拆开。它给出的关键诊断是：推理更强、答题更准，并不代表更会处理不确定性。

title: Limitations
局限
html: The space of unanswerable dialogue is open-ended, so the 20 datasets cannot cover every abstention case. Labels for subjectivity or missing context can be contestable, and the paper relies on an LLM judge despite manual validation. A model can also raise its score by refusing too often; inspect precision and answerable-question accuracy, not recall alone.
不可回答的对话情形没有穷尽，20 个数据集无法覆盖所有拒答场景。主观性和信息不足的标签可能有争议，且论文仍依赖模型判定器，尽管做过人工验证。模型还可能靠过度拒答刷分，因此不能只看召回率，必须同时看精确率和可回答题的正确性。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use it before deploying a question-answering or reasoning model: run the released prompts, record abstention recall, precision, and answer accuracy, then inspect false-premise and underspecified failures. It is useful for comparing prompting or post-training choices. Do not use its score alone as a safety clearance for clinical, legal, or other high-stakes deployment.
在部署问答或推理模型前，可运行公开题目，记录拒答召回率、精确率和作答正确率，再检查错误前提与信息不足题中的乱答。它适合比较提示词或后训练方案；但不能仅凭该分数批准医疗、法律等高风险场景上线。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. Treat abstention as calibrated behavior, not a keyword match.
  2. Check recall and precision together; high refusal can conceal poor usefulness.
  3. Keep answerable controls when testing uncertainty handling.
  4. Audit reasoning models separately: longer chains can still end in an unjustified definite answer.
  5. Re-run the released protocol when changing prompts, model versions, or decoding settings.

1. 拒答应被视为校准后的行为，而非匹配某个关键词。
  2. 召回率和精确率必须同时看，高拒答率可能掩盖低可用性。
  3. 测不确定性时必须保留可回答对照题。
  4. 推理模型要单独审计：长推理链仍可能以无依据的确定答案收尾。
  5. 更换提示词、模型版本或解码参数后，应重跑公开协议。
